brief.zh: 从同一块校准板做出两张不同的黑白模板，校验每张图的白色区域数和面积。
brief.en: Build two different masks from one calibration board. Check each mask’s region count and white area.

concept.zh: 阈值决定哪些亮度通过，模糊改变边缘亮度。看两项指标可以更精细地校准。
concept.en: Thresholding controls which brightness values pass. Blur shifts values around edges. Use both measurements to tune each mask.

hints.zh: 不模糊时，从较暗圆点的亮度 78 开始试。孤立最亮圆点后，用模糊再微调像素数。
hints.en: For the unblurred mask, try starting at the dimmest dot’s brightness of 78. Once you have isolated the brightest dot, tune its area with blur.

prompt.zh: 让最暗的圆点消失，留下 3 个白色区域，总共 11971 个白色像素。
prompt.en: Remove the dimmest dot. Keep three white regions with exactly 11,971 white pixels in total.

prompt.zh: 只保留最亮圆点。把白色像素数调到 5150 至 5200。
prompt.en: Keep only the brightest dot. Tune the white pixel count to 5,150–5,200.
